missing_data_policy: uncovered portal seasons are None; covered seasons with no matching transfer are zero; DirectRankModel applies training-only median imputation and missingness indicators

negative_control.method: permute transfer volume features within season

destination.reason: Final destination can reflect later portal resolution and is not proven knowable by August 15.

origin.reason: The source team is present in the retrospective record; source-team naming is not a historical roster snapshot.

portal_season.reason: The requested season is explicit, but the endpoint is not an archived as-of snapshot.

position.reason: The endpoint supplies a position but no archived as-of roster context.

prior_usage.reason: Prior-season usage is outcome data from the source school and is not itself target-season data, but the name-based portal join is not an archived roster join.

rating_stars.reason: Rating coverage and later corrections are not timestamped as-of the cutoff.

scholarship_player_count.reason: Eligibility does not establish scholarship status.
scholarship_player_count.source: not available in the selected CFBD fields

transfer_date.reason: A date allows deterministic cutoff filtering, but historical publication and revision timing are not archived.

selection.development_rule: lowest development NLL among transfer-aware candidates strictly below C0; otherwise fixed C2_transfer_volume sensitivity candidate
